title: With CROSSFILTER BOTH a filter on Sales cross-filters Product, which is still not filtered

source.quote: A filter on a related table does not make the table filtered, -- also when the relationship uses a bidirectional cross-filter.
source.supports: the page shows these results for a filter on Sales[Quantity] with CROSSFILTER BOTH

derivation: CROSSFILTER makes the relationship filter both ways for this evaluation, so the filter on Sales[Quantity] reaches Product: its columns are cross-filtered. Product has no direct filter, so ISFILTERED ( Product ) stays FALSE.
